🦅 Buddy — the giftable tool (1 of 3)

This is the actual gift: a single web page (works on phone) where each person uses their OWN free Google key. No D2M key inside. Open it locally to test: dist/gemini-buddy/gemini-buddy.html. Source below for review.

What it does: patient AI helper, plain-English answers, dignity-first UI, 3 starter buttons, optional smarter brain. Key saved on the user's device only. No phone-home.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Buddy — your patient AI helper</title>
<style>
  :root{ --cream:#f7f3ea; --ink:#0000ff; --navy:#003087; }
  *{ box-sizing:border-box; }
  body{ font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif; background:var(--cream); color:#1a1a1a;
        margin:0; padding:18px; line-height:1.5; }
  .wrap{ max-width:680px; margin:0 auto; }
  h1{ color:var(--navy); font-size:1.5rem; margin:.2em 0; }
  .sub{ color:#444; margin:0 0 16px; font-size:.95rem; }
  textarea,input{ width:100%; font-family:inherit; font-size:1.05rem; padding:12px;
        border:1px solid #c9bfa5; border-radius:10px; background:#fffdf7; }
  textarea{ min-height:90px; resize:vertical; }
  button{ font-family:inherit; font-size:1.05rem; background:var(--ink); color:#fff;
        border:0; border-radius:10px; padding:12px 20px; margin-top:10px; cursor:pointer; }
  button:disabled{ opacity:.5; cursor:wait; }
  .row{ display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .answer{ white-space:pre-wrap; background:#fffdf7; border:1px solid #c9bfa5; border-radius:10px;
        padding:16px; margin-top:16px; min-height:40px; }
  .chips button{ background:#eee6d2; color:var(--navy); font-size:.92rem; padding:8px 12px; margin:4px 4px 0 0; }
  .keybar{ background:#eee6d2; border-radius:10px; padding:12px; margin-bottom:16px; font-size:.9rem; }
  .keybar a{ color:var(--ink); }
  label{ font-size:.9rem; color:#333; }
  .foot{ color:#777; font-size:.8rem; margin-top:22px; text-align:center; }
  .hide{ display:none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
  <h1>Buddy</h1>
  <p class="sub">A patient helper that answers anything — in plain English. It's yours. You can't break it.</p>

  <!-- Key setup: shown only until a key is saved -->
  <div id="keybar" class="keybar">
    <b>One-time setup (≈2 min):</b> Get your own free key at
    <a href="https://aistudio.google.com/apikey" target="_blank" rel="noopener">aistudio.google.com/apikey</a>
    → sign in → <i>Create API key</i> → copy it → paste below. It stays on this device only.
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:10px;">
      <input id="key" type="password" placeholder="Paste your key here (starts with AIza...)" autocomplete="off">
      <button id="savekey">Save</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="chips" id="chips">
    <button data-p="Explain this letter in plain English and tell me what to do next: ">Explain a letter</button>
    <button data-p="Write a warm thank-you note. Here are the details: ">Write a thank-you note</button>
    <button data-p="Help me understand: ">Explain something</button>
  </div>

  <textarea id="q" placeholder="Type your question here, or tap a button above to start…"></textarea>
  <div class="row">
    <button id="ask">Ask</button>
    <label><input type="checkbox" id="pro"> Use the smarter (slower) brain</label>
    <button id="forget" style="background:#999; font-size:.85rem;">Change key</button>
  </div>

  <div id="answer" class="answer hide"></div>

  <p class="foot">A gift from a friend at Dreams2Memories. · It can be confidently wrong — double-check anything that matters. · Don't paste other people's private information.</p>
</div>

<script>
const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const LS = "buddy_gemini_key";
function refreshKeyUI(){ $("#keybar").classList.toggle("hide", !!localStorage.getItem(LS)); }
$("#savekey").onclick = () => {
  const k = $("#key").value.trim();
  if(!k){ alert("Paste your key first."); return; }
  localStorage.setItem(LS, k); $("#key").value=""; refreshKeyUI();
};
$("#forget").onclick = () => { localStorage.removeItem(LS); refreshKeyUI(); };
document.querySelectorAll("#chips button").forEach(b=>{
  b.onclick = () => { $("#q").value = b.dataset.p; $("#q").focus(); };
});
$("#ask").onclick = async () => {
  const key = localStorage.getItem(LS);
  if(!key){ alert("Do the one-time setup first (get your free key)."); refreshKeyUI(); return; }
  const q = $("#q").value.trim();
  if(!q){ return; }
  const model = $("#pro").checked ? "gemini-2.5-pro" : "gemini-2.5-flash";
  const ans = $("#answer"); ans.classList.remove("hide"); ans.textContent = "Thinking…";
  $("#ask").disabled = true;
  try{
    const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${model}:generateContent?key=${encodeURIComponent(key)}`;
    const r = await fetch(url, {
      method:"POST", headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
      body: JSON.stringify({ contents:[{ parts:[{ text:q }] }] })
    });
    const d = await r.json();
    if(d.candidates && d.candidates[0]){
      ans.textContent = d.candidates[0].content.parts.map(p=>p.text).join("");
    } else {
      ans.textContent = "Hmm — " + ((d.error && d.error.message) || "no answer came back. Check your key and try again.");
    }
  }catch(e){ ans.textContent = "Connection problem: " + e.message; }
  $("#ask").disabled = false;
};
refreshKeyUI();
</script>
</body>
</html>
